messages.content: You write alternative wordings for phrases used in training captions of a map search over US farm country (land cover, distances and NASA POWER climate). Reply with one JSON object only, no other text.

Each template is a clause that follows a land phrase, for example 'corn fields' + ' ' + template. {d} is a distance such as '300 m', {c} what it is measured to, {h} hectares, {season} a period of the year, {year} a year, {var} a climate variable, {adj} a word such as 'wettest', {p} a percentage, {n} a number of days, {t} a temperature in C, {mm} millimetres, {g} growing degree days, {tier} 'third' or 'half', {x} a sunlight amount.

For every key of the JSON object below, write exactly 8 NEW wordings that mean exactly the same as the existing ones, in plain US English, the way a farmer, planner or analyst might type them. Keep the same grammatical role (a noun phrase stays a noun phrase; a clause that follows a land phrase stays such a clause). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as written, once each, and add no new ones. Keep meanings exact: the same months, the same direction (more or less, within or beyond, highest or lowest). Do not repeat an existing wording. Never use any of these words: airport, church, creek, dam, dike, dirt track, ditch, drainage, dyke, elevator, grain elevator, greenhouse, greenhouses, highway, hospital, landfill, levee, mast, nursery, oil well, orchard, parking, petroleum, power line, power lines, radio, rail, railroad, railway, row of trees, school, shelterbelt, silo, stadium, stream, track, tree row, turbine, vineyard, wind turbine, wind turbines.

Reply with a JSON object with the same keys, each mapped to a list of 8 strings.

{
 "near.near_templates": [
  "within {d} of {c}",
  "less than {d} from {c}",
  "no more than {d} away from {c}"
 ],
 "near.far_templates": [
  "more than {d} from any {c}",
  "at least {d} away from {c}",
  "not within {d} of {c}"
 ],
 "patch.templates": [
  "in patches of at least {h} ha",
  "in blocks of {h} ha or more",
  "forming areas of at least {h} ha"
 ],
 "climate_year.templates": [
  "where {season} {year} {var} was in the {adj} {p}% of years since 2001",
  "with {var} in {season} {year} among the {adj} {p}% of 2001-2025",
  "where {season} {year} was one of the {adj} {p}% for {var} since 2001"
 ],
 "heat_days.templates": [
  "where {season} {year} had at least {n} days with a daily maximum above {t} C",
  "with {n} or more days over {t} C in {season} {year}",
  "where the daily maximum topped {t} C on at least {n} days in {season} {year}"
 ],
 "rain_total.templates_at_least": [
  "where {season} {year} rainfall was at least {mm} mm",
  "with {mm} mm or more of rain in {season} {year}",
  "that got at least {mm} mm of rain in {season} {year}"
 ],
 "rain_total.templates_at_most": [
  "where {season} {year} rainfall was {mm} mm or less",
  "with no more than {mm} mm of rain in {season} {year}",
  "that got at most {mm} mm of rain in {season} {year}"
 ],
 "gdd.templates_at_most": [
  "with fewer than {g} growing degree days (base 10 C) from May to September {year}",
  "where May-September {year} had at most {g} growing degree days (base 10 C)",
  "with {g} or fewer growing degree days in May-September {year}"
 ],
 "gdd.templates_at_least": [
  "with at least {g} growing degree days (base 10 C) from May to September {year}",
  "where May-September {year} had {g} or more growing degree days (base 10 C)",
  "with more than {g} growing degree days in May-September {year}"
 ],
 "climate_long.templates": [
  "in the {adj} {tier} of places by {var} over 2001-2025",
  "among the {tier} of places with the {adj} {var} (2001-2025 average)",
  "in the {adj} {tier} of the region for {var}, 2001-2025"
 ],
 "climate_long.sunlight_templates": [
  "where average sunlight over 2001-2025 is at least {x} kWh per square metre per day",
  "with long-term sunlight of {x} kWh/m2/day or more",
  "where the 2001-2025 solar resource is at least {x} kWh per square metre per day"
 ]
}
